reviews.title: Great Air cooler for 24 core and 64 core 7000 threadrippers
reviews.comment:
Great cooler! I have used the DH15 on my desktop platforms and now this model for both a 7960x and 7985wx. The coolers allow for extended uptime and heavy processing loads.
Keep in mind, it needs to be mounted in the upward position. So for builds with multiple consumer GPU's, which have coolers designed to expel heat into the case, make sure you have adequate cool air intake to offset that generated by the GPU.
reviews.author: Taylor L Sperring

reviews.title: I like it
reviews.comment: Don't know much about cooling systems but I couldn't find another system that fully covered the plate on the AMD 64 core threadripper and this one does cover it and keeps it cool. On idle it's running around 35c and under full load with all cores at 100% it's 71c.
reviews.author: My name is Mel

reviews.title: Awesome for regular CPU loads.
reviews.comment: This is a great CPU cooler. It only gets four stars from me since its cooling performance was ~10C hotter than my existing AIO. I had a lot of high hopes for this as it would have reduced my overall power consumption. The other thing I didn’t like about it was it came with several bent fins on the heatsink, for the price, I expected more.
reviews.author: Ryan McGuinness

reviews.title: Okay... I'm a fan
reviews.comment: Noctua makes great stuff and this is no exception.  Ran the 32-core Threadripper full out for 30 minutes and it never throttled back; impressive given the TDP of the chip is 350 watts.  The fans did spin up, but come on... I can live with that.
reviews.author: C S

reviews.title: Noctua Design Flaw
reviews.comment: Not super impressed by this model. This model flows air to the top which is bad. All hot air traps due to mesh which hovers across. Keeps pc and case hot. Traditional back flow works great for that reason, kept it as a backup. Wouldn't use it for primary use. To correct this problem you would need a custom design case or leave your motherboard exposed. This is fundamental design flaw.
reviews.author: Sharoon A.
